name: Ander McKee
bio: I'm a data analyst with a designer's eye. I find what the numbers are really saying, then design it so anyone can see.

projects.title: What 798 Films Say About Representation and Revenue
projects.summary: Films that pass the Bechdel test look no different at the box office until you account for the smaller budgets they're given. Then they earn about 22% more.
